newsitem.title: USA: Genesee & Wyoming agrees to buy Rail Link.
newsitem.headline: Genesee & Wyoming agrees to buy Rail Link.

text.p: Genesee & Wyoming Inc said on Monday it reached an agreement in principle to buy all of the common stock of Rail Link Inc, for undisclosed terms.
Rail Link, based in Virginia, provides railroad switching and related services to North American industries with extensive railroad facilities within their complexes. It is a unit of Varlen Corp.
Genesee said it filed with the Surface Transportation Board for approval to assume control of three short line railroads owned by Rail Link in Virginia, N. Carolina and Florida.
The deal was expected to close in the next two weeks, the company said, but it was subject to completion and execution of a definitive agreement.
